title: IkkatsuResourcePackKun
description: Toggling all the selected resource packs at once!
body:
# Ikkatsu Resource Pack Kun
Ikkatsu Resource Pack Kun is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that lets you assign multiple resource packs to a single keybind and toggle them all on or off at once — no more diving into the settings menu every time.

# ✨ Features
## One-key toggle
Press Ctrl + ` (apostrophe) （※日本語キーボードの場合は「：」キー）in-game to enable or disable all your selected resource packs simultaneously. An on-screen message confirms the current state at a glance.

## Persistent state across sessions
Your selected packs and their enabled/disabled state are saved to a config file (bulk_toggle_config.json). The mod automatically restores the correct state every time you launch the game.

## Intuitive config screen (via Mod Menu)
Open the mod's settings through Mod Menu to see a list of all available resource packs, each with a simple toggle switch. Internal packs (Vanilla, High Contrast, Programmer Art) and Fabric mod-embedded resource packs are automatically hidden to keep the list clean.

## Automatic resource pack reload
Whenever you toggle packs, the game's resource pack manager is updated and a reload is triggered automatically — no manual steps required.

# 📦 Requirements
・Fabric Loader

・Fabric API

・Cloth Config

・Mod Menu (for config screen)

# 🎮 How to Use

Open Mod Menu and navigate to this mod's config screen.
Toggle on the resource packs you want to group together.
Save and close the screen.
In-game, press Ctrl + ` to enable/disable all selected packs at once.
